text:
Hi there,

I'm looking to hire your Hartwell for my sister's wedding day, so it's available on 24 June 2027 at 10:00 and will be returned on 26th June 2027 at 17:30. Could you deliver it to and collect it from St Aldhelm's Church, Marlhaven? I'd like it to be driven by one of your chauffeurs and decorated with ribbons and flowers. I have attached my driving licence for your reference.

Best wishes,
Willa Braithwell +70 222 560 7770
